description: Measure a recorded flow by starting a complete Chrome trace, replaying the flow, and stopping the trace. Returns replay results and compact trace insights; set includeEvents to include the larger raw event summary.

includeEvents.description: Include raw trace event summaries in the response; default false

tabId.description: Positive Chrome tab ID; required so trace and replay stay on the same tab. Negative isolated-context IDs are unsupported because replay may replace tabs that Chrome tabs.get cannot resolve.
